title: Differentiated weak Euler-Lagrange system for a C^2 weak solution (difference quotients)
statement: Let n, l be natural numbers, L := L(R^n, R^l) (= Rn n →L[ℝ] Rn ℓ, operator norm) and Psi : L -> R of class C^2. Let U ⊆ R^n be open and u, g : R^n -> R^l with u of class C^2 on U and g continuous on U. Suppose that ∫_U DPsi(Du(x))[Dphi(x)] dx = -∫_U <phi(x), g(x)> dx for every C^1 map phi : R^n -> R^l with compact support and tsupport phi ⊆ U. Then for every e ∈ R^n and every C^1 map zeta : R^n -> R^l with compact support and tsupport zeta ⊆ U, ∫_U D^2Psi(Du(x))[Dv_e(x)][Dzeta(x)] dx = ∫_U <g(x), Dzeta(x)e> dx. Here v_e(z) := Du(z)e = fderiv R u z e and D^2Psi(P)[Q][Q'] := fderiv R (fderiv R Psi) P Q Q'.
lean_statement: ∀ n ℓ : ℕ, ∀ (Ψ : (Rn n →L[ℝ] Rn ℓ) → ℝ) (U : Set (Rn n)) (u g : Rn n → Rn ℓ), IsOpen U → ContDiff ℝ 2 Ψ → ContDiffOn ℝ 2 u U → ContinuousOn g U → (∀ φ : Rn n → Rn ℓ, ContDiff ℝ 1 φ → HasCompactSupport φ → tsupport φ ⊆ U → ∫ x in U, fderiv ℝ Ψ (fderiv ℝ u x) (fderiv ℝ φ x) = -∫ x in U, inner ℝ (φ x) (g x)) → ∀ (e : Rn n) (ζ : Rn n → Rn ℓ), ContDiff ℝ 1 ζ → HasCompactSupport ζ → tsupport ζ ⊆ U → ∫ x in U, fderiv ℝ (fderiv ℝ Ψ) (fderiv ℝ u x) (fderiv ℝ (fun z => fderiv ℝ u z e) x) (fderiv ℝ ζ x) = ∫ x in U, inner ℝ (g x) (fderiv ℝ ζ x e)
